translation.status: AI-assisted working translation, NOT validated Chinese adaptation

empirical_thresholds.policy: No clinical thresholds established in sources reviewed; do not invent low/medium/high bands from reference means or response midpoint.

deployment.report_policy: Descriptive response explanation only; no clinical, ability, placement or counseling decisions from score.

illustration.brief: Optional original neutral abstract horizon/steps icon; avoid borrowed scale diagrams and diagnostic traffic-light zones.

name.zh: 一般自我效能短量表（3题，中文工作译稿）

not_same_as: Schwarzer and Jerusalem 10-item General Self-Efficacy Scale
deduplication.note: ASKU and GSE-3 are language adaptations in one family, not two new independent additions.

instructions.en: The following statements may apply more or less to you. To what extent do you think each statement applies to you personally?
instructions.zh: 以下陈述与你的实际情况可能有不同程度的符合。你认为每项陈述在多大程度上符合你个人的情况？

items.en: I can rely on my own abilities in difficult situations.
items.zh: 在困难的情况下，我可以依靠自己的能力。

items.en: I am able to solve most problems on my own.
items.zh: 我能够独立解决大多数问题。

items.en: I can usually solve even challenging and complex tasks well.
items.zh: 即使是具有挑战性且复杂的任务，我通常也能很好地完成。

scoring.direction: Higher reflects greater reported confidence in own competence, not tested competence.
scoring.precision: Keep full precision internally; display at most2decimals.

references.role: documentation, scoring, source lineage, reference samples and license

empirical_reference.purpose: metadata only, NOT Chinese or youth norms
empirical_reference.design: January2018 native-speaker online quota samples, CASI, ages18–69; not national probability samples

feedback.complete: 你的作答均分为 {score}（取值范围1–5）。较高的分数表示你更认同自己能够应对困难和解决问题。这描述的是自我效能信念，并不等于实际能力测验结果。本中文版本尚未经验证，不能据此判断能力高低、心理健康状况或作出教育决策。
feedback.incomplete: 有题目尚未作答，因此不计算均分。
feedback.reflection: 如果仅用于自我思考，可以记录一个你曾成功处理的困难，以及当时对你有帮助的行动或支持。此建议不是量表作者的计分解释。

original_german.reason: English official adaptation selected as canonical source for Chinese working translation. Do not merge German-source license with English adaptation grant. German wording can be consulted at original ZIS source, but is not an additional deployable language pack here.
